user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Crewmeister account.

data_description.base_url: Only change this if Crewmeister told you to use a different API endpoint.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Crewmeister
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer valid. Please enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Crewmeister API.
error.no_identity: Your Crewmeister profile could not be determined.
error.insecure_url: The API URL must start with https:// so that the password is sent encrypted.

abort.already_configured: This Crewmeister account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different Crewmeister account.

init.title: Crewmeister settings
init.description: All features are optional. Each area is saved as soon as you submit it.

menu_option_descriptions.schedule: Working days, target working time, public holidays
menu_option_descriptions.notifications: Choose your phone, live display, confirmations
menu_option_descriptions.auto_stamp: Automatic stamping via zones, Wi-Fi, NFC
menu_option_descriptions.home_office: Automatic stamping via power plug and presence sensor
menu_option_descriptions.reminders: End of day, forgotten clock out
menu_option_descriptions.breaks: Break reminder, lunch break, break check

schedule.title: Working time
schedule.description: Basis for the end of day reminder, the live display and automatic clock in.

data_description.workdays: No automatic clock in on other days.
data_description.daily_hours: Target working time on working days without an own value below. Used for the end of day reminder, the live display and the forgotten clock out offer.
data_description.workday_entity: Optional, e.g. from the Workday integration to skip public holidays.

weekday_hours.name: Different target time per weekday
weekday_hours.description: Empty = daily target time, 0 = no target on that day.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Questions, reminders and the live display are delivered via the Home Assistant Companion App (Android and iOS).

data.notify_live: Live display (iOS Live Activity / Android Live Update)

data_description.notify_targets: Home Assistant Companion App devices (notify.mobile_app_…). Without a device no notifications are sent.
data_description.notify_confirmations: Send a short confirmation after each stamp made by the assistant.
data_description.notify_live: Shows work time with a running timer, progress towards your target time and the expected end of day on the lock screen. Requires Home Assistant 2026.7, iOS 17.2 or the current Android app. Replaces the ongoing status notification.
data_description.notify_status: Shows a permanent notification with a running timer and buttons while you work. Not used if the live display is on.
data_description.live_icon_work: Shown in the live display, e.g. mdi:account-hard-hat.
data_description.live_icon_break: Shown in the live display, e.g. mdi:pretzel.

auto_stamp.title: Office
auto_stamp.description: {notify_hint}Choose how being at work is detected and what happens when you arrive and leave.

data_description.person: Home Assistant person of this Crewmeister user.
data_description.work_zones: Being in one of these zones counts as being at work.
data_description.wifi_sensor: Wi-Fi connection sensor of the Companion App (more reliable than GPS).
data_description.wifi_ssids: Being connected to one of these networks counts as being at work.
data_description.presence_entities: Binary sensors or input booleans that are on while you are at work.

data_description.clock_in_mode: Off, ask via notification or stamp automatically.
data_description.clock_out_mode: Off, ask via notification or stamp automatically.
data_description.backdate: Stamps get the time you actually arrived or left instead of the time of the stamp.
data_description.short_leave_break: With automatic clock out: an absence up to this long is stamped as a break instead. 0 = off.

timing.name: Delays and time window
timing.description: Protects against GPS jumps and stamping at the wrong time.

data.once_per_day: Clock in automatically only once a day

data_description.arrival_delay: You must be at work this long before anything happens (protects against GPS jumps).
data_description.departure_delay: You must be away this long before anything happens.

data_description.nfc_tags: Scanning one of these tags clocks in or out immediately.

home_office.title: Home office
home_office.description: {notify_hint}Working from home is detected when you are at home on a working day and one of the signals is active.

detection.name: Detection
detection.description: One signal is enough. The person must be at home.

data_description.home_office_power_threshold: From this power on the PC counts as in use. Choose more than the standby consumption.
data_description.home_office_presence_sensors: E.g. a presence sensor at the desk or “session unlocked” from HASS.Agent.

data_description.home_office_clock_in_mode: Off, ask via notification or clock in automatically.
data_description.home_office_clock_out_mode: Off, ask or clock out automatically when there is no more activity. The stamp gets the time the inactivity began.
data_description.home_office_short_break: With automatic clock out: inactivity up to this long is stamped as a break, longer as end of work. 0 = off.

data_description.home_office_activity_delay: A signal must be active this long without interruption.
data_description.home_office_idle_timeout: Without any signal for this long, work counts as ended or interrupted.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: {notify_hint}Reminders have buttons to clock out and to remind you later.

data_description.end_of_day_reminder: Asks whether to clock out once clock in time + target working time + required break + grace period has passed.
data_description.end_of_day_grace: Time after reaching the target working time before you are reminded.
data_description.max_work_hours: Warns when today's working time reaches this value. 0 = off.

data.forgotten_check_time: Check for forgotten clock out at

data_description.remind_on_leave: If departures are not handled automatically, you are reminded when you leave while still clocked in.
data_description.reminder_time: Reminds you at this time if you are still clocked in. Empty = off.
data_description.forgotten_check_time: If a shift from a previous day is still running, you are offered to clock out with the time you left. Empty = off.
data_description.snooze_minutes: Delay of the "Remind me later" button.

breaks.title: Breaks
breaks.description: {notify_hint}Reminds you of breaks and checks the required break when you clock out.

data.break_end_reminder: Notify when the break is over
data.auto_resume: Resume work automatically after the break

data_description.break_reminder_after: Continuous working time without a break. 0 = off.
data_description.break_duration: Used for the end-of-break notification, automatic resume and lunch break.
data_description.lunch_break_time: Starts a break at this time if you are clocked in. Empty = off.

break_check.name: Break check when clocking out
break_check.description: Defaults follow the German Working Hours Act.

data_description.break_check: If the break was too short, you are offered to add the missing break.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: You normally do not need to change these values.

data.absence_states: Absence states shown in the calendar

data_description.update_interval: How often the stamp status is fetched from Crewmeister (300–3600 seconds).
data_description.absence_states: Absences with these states appear in the calendar.
data_description.stamp_note: Added to stamps created by buttons, or by the service when it has no note.
data_description.stamp_time_account_id: Time account assigned to stamps unless the service call specifies one.

location.name: Location on stamps
location.description: Optionally the work location is sent with every stamp made via Home Assistant. Your employer can see it in Crewmeister as well.

data_description.location_as_note: For accounts that are not allowed to set the location of a stamp (error when stamping): the location is appended to the note instead.

no_shift_to_pause.message: There is no active shift to pause.

no_shift_to_clock_out.message: There is no active shift to clock out from.

stamp_failed.message: Failed to create the Crewmeister stamp: {error}

entry_not_found.message: Crewmeister configuration entry {entry_id} was not found.

entry_not_loaded.message: Crewmeister configuration entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several Crewmeister accounts are configured. Select the account to stamp for.

insecure_url.message: The Crewmeister API URL does not use HTTPS. Please set up the integration again with an https:// address.

note.name: Note
note.description: Note attached to the stamp. Overrides the default note.

time_account_id.name: Time account ID
time_account_id.description: Time account assigned to the stamp. Overrides the default time account.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Crewmeister account to stamp for. Required if several accounts are configured.
